about: Census 2010 tracts whose codes or boundaries Census changed after the 2006-2010 ACS. The 2010->2020 crosswalk is keyed to the original 2010 codes; later periods still on 2010 tracts (2011-15, 2015-19) carry the corrected ones. Every pairing below was derived from the boundaries (cb_2010 vs cb_2015 1:500k tract files): the old tract's interior point falls in the new tract, and the area ratio (new/old) is recorded. Population for 'boundary' rows is from the cubes. Used by etl/harmonize.py.

kinds.recode: Same tract, new code (county renamed or merged, or Census code correction). The crosswalk row is re-keyed; nothing is estimated.
kinds.merge: The old tract was absorbed into an existing tract and had no people, households or housing units in 2010, so pooling its crosswalk rows into the absorbing tract changes no weight.
kinds.boundary: The boundary moved and populated area changed tracts. The 2010->2020 crosswalk cannot apportion the corrected tracts, so every 2020 tract they touch is left without a value for these periods, rather than shown with a partial sum.
